conclusion: All eight unmodified original GB10 cases pass. Whole 441f0f2 repairs every captured layer-2 linear/state/MoE endpoint in the first accepted decode row of both cases. The first full-attention input norm matches, but QKV, rotary, gated context and residual differ. Original-input K16 projections, BF16 rotary/gating and the exact 32-token attention replay match their original endpoints. Norm variants all match these two rows and do not uniquely identify a reduction tree. These causal operator controls do not qualify a whole-model continuation, a performance result or a release.
